record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872> and to Aaron<WH0175>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800> unto them,

Speak<WH01696><WTH8761> unto the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, These<WH02063> <FI>are<Fi> the beasts<WH02416> which ye shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> among all the beasts<WH0929> that <FI>are<Fi> on the earth<WH0776>.

Whatsoever parteth<WH06536><WTH8688> the hoof<WH06541>, and is clovenfooted<WH08156><WTH8802><WH08157>, <FI>and<Fi> cheweth<WH05927><WTH8688> the cud<WH01625>, among the beasts<WH0929>, that shall ye eat<WH0398><WTH8799>.

Nevertheless<WH0389> these shall ye not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of them that chew<WH05927><WTH8688> the cud<WH01625>, or of them that divide<WH06536><WTH8688> the hoof<WH06541>: <FI>as<Fi> the camel<WH01581>, because he cheweth<WH05927><WTH8688> the cud<WH01625>, but divideth<WH06536><WTH8688> not the hoof<WH06541>; he <FI>is<Fi> unclean<WH02931> unto you.
And the coney<WH08227>, because he cheweth<WH05927><WTH8688> the cud<WH01625>, but divideth<WH06536><WTH8686> not the hoof<WH06541>; he <FI>is<Fi> unclean<WH02931> unto you.
And the hare<WH0768>, because he cheweth<WH05927><WTH8688> the cud<WH01625>, but divideth<WH06536><WTH8689> not the hoof<WH06541>; he <FI>is<Fi> unclean<WH02931> unto you.

And the swine<WH02386>, though he divide<WH06536><WTH8688> the hoof<WH06541>, and be clovenfooted<WH08156><WTH8802><WH08157>, yet he cheweth<WH01641><WTH8735> not the cud<WH01625>; he <FI>is<Fi> unclean<WH02931> to you.
Of their flesh<WH01320> shall ye not eat<WH0398><WTH8799>, and their carcase<WH05038> shall ye not touch<WH05060><WTH8799>; they <FI>are<Fi> unclean<WH02931> to you.<CM>

These shall ye eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of all that <FI>are<Fi> in the waters<WH04325>: whatsoever hath fins<WH05579> and scales<WH07193> in the waters<WH04325>, in the seas<WH03220>, and in the rivers<WH05158>, them shall ye eat<WH0398><WTH8799>.

And all that have not fins<WH05579> and scales<WH07193> in the seas<WH03220>, and in the rivers<WH05158>, of all that move<WH08318> in the waters<WH04325>, and of any living<WH02416> thing<WH05315> which <FI>is<Fi> in the waters<WH04325>, they <FI>shall be<Fi> an abomination<WH08263> unto you:
They shall be even an abomination<WH08263> unto you; ye shall not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of their flesh<WH01320>, but ye shall have their carcases<WH05038> in abomination<WH08262><WTH8762>.
Whatsoever hath no fins<WH05579> nor scales<WH07193> in the waters<WH04325>, that <FI>shall be<Fi> an abomination<WH08263> unto you.

And these <FI>are they which<Fi> ye shall have in abomination<WH08262><WTH8762> among<WH04480> the fowls<WH05775>; they shall not be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735>, they <FI>are<Fi> an abomination<WH08263>: the eagle<WH05404>, and the ossifrage<WH06538>, and the ospray<WH05822>,
And the vulture<WH01676>, and the kite<WH0344> after his kind<WH04327>;
Every raven<WH06158> after his kind<WH04327>;
And the owl<WH01323><WH03284>, and the night hawk<WH08464>, and the cuckow<WH07828>, and the hawk<WH05322> after his kind<WH04327>,
And the little owl<WH03563>, and the cormorant<WH07994>, and the great owl<WH03244>,
And the swan<WH08580>, and the pelican<WH06893>, and the gier eagle<WH07360>,
And the stork<WH02624>, the heron<WH0601> after her kind<WH04327>, and the lapwing<WH01744>, and the bat<WH05847>.<CM>
All fowls<WH05775> that creep<WH08318>, going<WH01980><WTH8802> upon <FI>all<Fi> four<WH0702>, <FI>shall be<Fi> an abomination<WH08263> unto you.

Yet these may ye eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of every flying<WH05775> creeping<WH08318> thing that goeth<WH01980><WTH8802> upon <FI>all<Fi> four<WH0702>, which have legs<WH03767> above<WH04605> their feet<WH07272>, to leap<WH05425><WTH8763> withal<WH02004> upon the earth<WH0776>;

<FI> Even<Fi> these of them ye may eat<WH0398><WTH8799>; the locust<WH0697> after his kind<WH04327>, and the bald locust<WH05556> after his kind<WH04327>, and the beetle<WH02728> after his kind<WH04327>, and the grasshopper<WH02284> after his kind<WH04327>.
But all <FI>other<Fi> flying<WH05775> creeping things<WH08318>, which have four<WH0702> feet<WH07272>, <FI>shall be<Fi> an abomination<WH08263> unto you.
And for these ye shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8691>: whosoever toucheth<WH05060><WTH8802> the carcase<WH05038> of them shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799> until the even<WH06153>.
And whosoever beareth<WH05375><WTH8802> <FI>ought<Fi> of the carcase<WH05038> of them shall wash<WH03526><WTH8762> his clothes<WH0899>, and be unclean<WH02930><WTH8804> until the even<WH06153>.

<FI> The carcases<Fi> of every beast<WH0929> which divideth<WH06536><WTH8688> the hoof<WH06541>, and <FI>is<Fi> not clovenfooted<WH08157><WH08156><WTH8802>, nor cheweth<WH05927><WTH8688> the cud<WH01625>, <FI>are<Fi> unclean<WH02931> unto you: every one that toucheth<WH05060><WTH8802> them shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799>.

And whatsoever<WH03605><WH01992> goeth<WH01980><WTH8802> upon his paws<WH03709>, among all manner of beasts<WH02416> that go<WH01980><WTH8802> on <FI>all<Fi> four<WH0702>, those <FI>are<Fi> unclean<WH02931> unto you: whoso toucheth<WH05060><WTH8802> their carcase<WH05038> shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799> until the even<WH06153>.

And he that beareth<WH05375><WTH8802> the carcase<WH05038> of them shall wash<WH03526><WTH8762> his clothes<WH0899>, and be unclean<WH02930><WTH8804> until the even<WH06153>: they <FI>are<Fi> unclean<WH02931> unto you.

These also <FI>shall be<Fi> unclean<WH02931> unto you among the creeping things<WH08318> that creep<WH08317><WTH8802> upon the earth<WH0776>; the weasel<WH02467>, and the mouse<WH05909>, and the tortoise<WH06632> after his kind<WH04327>,
And the ferret<WH0604>, and the chameleon<WH03581>, and the lizard<WH03911>, and the snail<WH02546>, and the mole<WH08580>.

These <FI>are<Fi> unclean<WH02931> to you among all that creep<WH08318>: whosoever doth touch<WH05060><WTH8802> them, when they be dead<WH04194>, shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799> until the even<WH06153>.

And upon whatsoever <FI>any<Fi> of them, when they are dead<WH04194>, doth fall<WH05307><WTH8799>, it shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799>; whether <FI>it be<Fi> any vessel<WH03627> of wood<WH06086>, or raiment<WH0899>, or skin<WH05785>, or sack<WH08242>, whatsoever vessel<WH03627> <FI>it be<Fi> , wherein <FI>any<Fi> work<WH04399> is done<WH06213><WTH8735>, it must be put<WH0935><WTH8714> into water<WH04325>, and it shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8804> until the even<WH06153>; so it shall be cleansed<WH02891><WTH8804>.

And every earthen<WH02789> vessel<WH03627>, whereinto <FI>any<Fi> of them falleth<WH05307><WTH8799><WH08432>, whatsoever <FI>is<Fi> in it shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799>; and ye shall break<WH07665><WTH8799> it.

Of all meat<WH0400> which may be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735>, <FI>that<Fi> on which <FI>such<Fi> water<WH04325> cometh<WH0935><WTH8799> shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799>: and all drink<WH04945> that may be drunk<WH08354><WTH8735> in every <FI>such<Fi>  vessel<WH03627> shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799>.

And every <FI>thing<Fi> whereupon <FI>any part<Fi> of their carcase<WH05038> falleth<WH05307><WTH8799> shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799>; <FI>whether it be<Fi> oven<WH08574>, or ranges<WH03600> for pots, they shall be broken down<WH05422><WTH8714>: <FI>for<Fi> they <FI>are<Fi> unclean<WH02931>, and shall be unclean<WH02931> unto you.

Nevertheless a fountain<WH04599> or pit<WH0953>, <FI>wherein there is<Fi> plenty<WH04723> of water<WH04325>, shall be clean<WH02889>: but that which toucheth<WH05060><WTH8802> their carcase<WH05038> shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799>. <RF>wherein...: Heb. a gathering together of waters<Rf>
And if <FI>any part<Fi> of their carcase<WH05038> fall<WH05307><WTH8799> upon any sowing<WH02221> seed<WH02233> which is to be sown<WH02232><WTH8735>, it <FI>shall be<Fi> clean<WH02889>.

But if <FI>any<Fi> water<WH04325> be put<WH05414><WTH8714> upon the seed<WH02233>, and <FI>any part<Fi> of their carcase<WH05038> fall<WH05307><WTH8804> thereon, it <FI>shall be<Fi> unclean<WH02931> unto you.

And if any beast<WH0929>, of which ye may eat<WH0402>, die<WH04191><WTH8799>; he that toucheth<WH05060><WTH8802> the carcase<WH05038> thereof shall be unclean<WH02930><WTH8799> until the even<WH06153>.

And he that eateth<WH0398><WTH8802> of the carcase<WH05038> of it shall wash<WH03526><WTH8762> his clothes<WH0899>, and be unclean<WH02930><WTH8804> until the even<WH06153>: he also that beareth<WH05375><WTH8802> the carcase<WH05038> of it shall wash<WH03526><WTH8762> his clothes<WH0899>, and be unclean<WH02930><WTH8804> until the even<WH06153>.
And every creeping thing<WH08318> that creepeth<WH08317><WTH8802> upon the earth<WH0776> <FI>shall be<Fi> an abomination<WH08263>; it shall not be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735>.

Whatsoever goeth<WH01980><WTH8802> upon the belly<WH01512>, and whatsoever goeth<WH01980><WTH8802> upon <FI>all<Fi> four<WH0702>, or whatsoever hath more<WH07235><WTH8688> feet<WH07272> among all creeping things<WH08318> that creep<WH08317><WTH8802> upon the earth<WH0776>, them ye shall not eat<WH0398><WTH8799>; for they <FI>are<Fi> an abomination<WH08263>. <RF>hath...: Heb. doth multiply feet<Rf><CM>

Ye shall not make<WH08262><WH00> yourselves<WH05315> abominable<WH08262><WTH8762> with any creeping thing<WH08318> that creepeth<WH08317><WTH8802>, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean<WH02933><WTH8738> with them, that ye should be defiled<WH02930><WTH8691> thereby. <RF>yourselves abominable: Heb. your souls, etc<Rf>

For I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves<WH06942><WTH8694>, and ye shall be holy<WH06918>; for I <FI>am<Fi> holy<WH06918>: neither shall ye defile<WH02930><WTH8762> yourselves<WH05315> with any manner of creeping thing<WH08318> that creepeth<WH07430><WTH8802> upon the earth<WH0776>.

For I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> that bringeth<WH05927><WTH8688> you up out of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, to be your God<WH0430>: ye shall therefore be holy<WH06918>, for I <FI>am<Fi> holy<WH06918>.

This <FI>is<Fi> the law<WH08451> of the beasts<WH0929>, and of the fowl<WH05775>, and of every living<WH02416> creature<WH05315> that moveth<WH07430><WTH8802> in the waters<WH04325>, and of every creature<WH05315> that creepeth<WH08317><WTH8802> upon the earth<WH0776>:

To make a difference<WH0914><WTH8687> between the unclean<WH02931> and the clean<WH02889>, and between the beast<WH02416> that may be eaten<WH0398><WTH8737> and the beast<WH02416> that may not be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735>.<CM>
